# WikiLinks Extension for Python-Markdown
# ======================================

# Converts [[WikiLinks]] to relative links.

# See https://Python-Markdown.github.io/extensions/wikilinks
# for documentation.

# Original code Copyright [Waylan Limberg](https://github.com/waylan).

# All changes Copyright The Python Markdown Project

# License: [BSD](https://opensource.org/licenses/bsd-license.php)

"""
Converts `[[WikiLinks]]` to relative links.

See the [documentation](https://Python-Markdown.github.io/extensions/wikilinks)
for details.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from . import Extension
from ..inlinepatterns import InlineProcessor
import xml.etree.ElementTree as etree
import re
from typing import Any


def build_url(label: str, base: str, end: str) -> str:
    """ Build a URL from the label, a base, and an end. """
    clean_label = re.sub(r'([ ]+_)|(_[ ]+)|([ ]+)', '_', label)
    return '{}{}{}'.format(base, clean_label, end)


class WikiLinkExtension(Extension):
    """ Add inline processor to Markdown. """

    def __init__(self, **kwargs):
        self.config = {
            'base_url': ['/', 'String to append to beginning or URL.'],
            'end_url': ['/', 'String to append to end of URL.'],
            'html_class': ['wikilink', 'CSS hook. Leave blank for none.'],
            'build_url': [build_url, 'Callable formats URL from label.'],
        }
        """ Default configuration options. """
        super().__init__(**kwargs)

    def extendMarkdown(self, md):
        """ Register the processor.

        | Class Instance                                                              | Registry                                                         | Name   | Priority |
        | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ | :------: |
        | [`WikiLinksInlineProcessor`][markdown.extensions.wikilinks.WikiLinksInlineProcessor] | [`inlinepatterns`][markdown.inlinepatterns.build_inlinepatterns] | `wikilink` | `75` |

        """
        # flake8: noqa: E501 53-55
        self.md = md

        # append to end of inline patterns
        WIKILINK_RE = r'\[\[([\w0-9_ -]+)\]\]'
        wikilinkPattern = WikiLinksInlineProcessor(WIKILINK_RE, self.getConfigs())
        wikilinkPattern.md = md
        md.inlinePatterns.register(wikilinkPattern, 'wikilink', 75)


class WikiLinksInlineProcessor(InlineProcessor):
    """ Build link from `wikilink`. """

    def __init__(self, pattern: str, config: dict[str, Any]):
        super().__init__(pattern)
        self.config = config

    def handleMatch(self, m: re.Match[str], data: str) -> tuple[etree.Element | str, int, int]:
        if m.group(1).strip():
            base_url, end_url, html_class = self._getMeta()
            label = m.group(1).strip()
            url = self.config['build_url'](label, base_url, end_url)
            a = etree.Element('a')
            a.text = label
            a.set('href', url)
            if html_class:
                a.set('class', html_class)
        else:
            a = ''
        return a, m.start(0), m.end(0)

    def _getMeta(self) -> tuple[str, str, str]:
        """ Return meta data or `config` data. """
        base_url = self.config['base_url']
        end_url = self.config['end_url']
        html_class = self.config['html_class']
        if hasattr(self.md, 'Meta'):
            if 'wiki_base_url' in self.md.Meta:
                base_url = self.md.Meta['wiki_base_url'][0]
            if 'wiki_end_url' in self.md.Meta:
                end_url = self.md.Meta['wiki_end_url'][0]
            if 'wiki_html_class' in self.md.Meta:
                html_class = self.md.Meta['wiki_html_class'][0]
        return base_url, end_url, html_class


def makeExtension(**kwargs):  # pragma: no cover
    return WikiLinkExtension(**kwargs)

# Spec: Wikilinks: allow custom link text with `[[Page Name|link text]]` ## 1. Summary and scope The `wikilinks` extension (`markdown/extensions/wikilinks.py`) only recognises `[[Label]]`. The pattern is `WIKILINK_RE = r'\[\[([\w0-9_ -]+)\]\]'` (line 62). The label sets both the URL, through `build_url(label, base_url, end_url)`, and the link text (`a.text = label`, line 81). A `|` is not in the allowed character class, so `[[Installation Guide|see the install docs]]` does not match and is left as literal text [FACT, from the issue and the code]. The issue asks for MediaWiki-style piped links. In `[[Page Name|link text]]`, the part before `|` sets the URL in exactly the same way as `[[Page Name]]`. The part after `|` becomes the visible text. **In scope** - Recognise `[[Page Name|link text]]` and render it as a link whose `href` and `class` match those of `[[Page Name]]`, and whose text is `link text`. - The page name goes through the same URL path as plain links: `base_url`, `end_url`, `html_class`, a custom `build_url`, and the `wiki_base_url` / `wiki_end_url` / `wiki_html_class` meta-data overrides. - Leading and trailing whitespace is ignored around the page name and around the text. - If the text part is empty or contains only whitespace, the page name is used as the text. - Plain `[[Page Name]]` links, including the empty `[[ ]]` case, behave exactly as they do now. **Out of scope** - Other MediaWiki syntax: namespaces (`[[Help:X]]`), anchors (`[[Page#Section]]`), the pipe trick (`[[Page (x)|]]` stripping), link trails (`[[Page]]s`), templates. - Widening the character set allowed in the page name (it stays `[\w0-9_ -]`). - New configuration options. - Documentation wording. A maintainer may update `docs/extensions/wikilinks.md`, but this spec does not require it. ## 2. Functional requirements ```yaml id: "FR-001" title: "Render piped wikilinks with custom link text" statement: "The wikilinks extension SHALL convert `[[|]]` into an `` element whose `href` and `class` attributes are identical to those produced for `[[]]` under the same configuration and meta-data, and whose text content is with leading and trailing whitespace removed." epistemic_status: "FACT" source: "Issue #3: 'Could `wikilinks` support `[[Page Name|link text]]`? The link should point exactly where `[[Page Name]]` points (we rely on `base_url`, `end_url`, `html_class`, a custom `build_url` and the `wiki_*` meta-data overrides), just with different text. Whitespace around the name or the text shouldn't matter'. Current behaviour: markdown/extensions/wikilinks.py lines 62, 75-87, 89-101; tests/test_extensions.py TestWikiLinks." actor: "Document author using the wikilinks extension (e.g. migrating a MediaWiki wiki)" priority: "MUST_HAVE" readiness_status: "PROVISIONAL" dependencies: [] inputs: - {name: "source", type: "str", description: "Markdown containing `[[name|text]]`"} - {name: "config", type: "dict", description: "base_url, end_url, html_class, build_url; optional Meta wiki_base_url / wiki_end_url / wiki_html_class"} outputs: - {name: "html", type: "str", description: "HTML containing text"} acceptance_criteria: - id: "AC-FR-001-01" scenario: "Basic piped link with default config" given: "markdown.Markdown(extensions=['wikilinks'])" when: "converting '[[Installation Guide|see the install docs]]'" then: "output is exactly '

see the install docs

'" - id: "AC-FR-001-02" scenario: "Whitespace around name and text is ignored" given: "markdown.Markdown(extensions=['wikilinks'])" when: "converting '[[ Installation Guide | see the install docs ]]'" then: "output is exactly '

see the install docs

'" - id: "AC-FR-001-03" scenario: "Simple settings apply to piped links" given: "WikiLinkExtension(base_url='/wiki/', end_url='.html', html_class='foo')" when: "converting 'Some text with a [[WikiLink|a link]].'" then: "output is exactly '

Some text with a a link.

'" - id: "AC-FR-001-04" scenario: "Empty html_class omits class attribute" given: "extension_configs {'wikilinks': {'base_url': 'http://example.com/', 'end_url': '.html', 'html_class': ''}}" when: "converting '[[WikiLink|a link]]'" then: "output is exactly '

a link

'" - id: "AC-FR-001-05" scenario: "Meta-data overrides apply to piped links" given: "markdown.Markdown(extensions=['meta', 'wikilinks']) and source 'wiki_base_url: http://example.com/\\nwiki_end_url: .html\\nwiki_html_class:\\n\\nSome text with a [[WikiLink|a link]].'" when: "converting the source" then: "output is exactly '

Installation Guide

'" - id: "AC-FR-002-02" scenario: "Whitespace-only text falls back to the stripped page name" given: "markdown.Markdown(extensions=['wikilinks'])" when: "converting '[[ Installation Guide | ]]'" then: "output is exactly '

Installation Guide

'" - id: "AC-FR-002-03" scenario: "Plain wikilinks unchanged" given: "markdown.Markdown(extensions=['wikilinks'])" when: "converting 'Some text with a [[WikiLink]].', '[[ foo bar_baz ]]' and 'foo [[ ]] bar'" then: "outputs are exactly '

', '

foo bar_baz

foo bar

'; all existing TestWikiLinks tests and the legacy tests/extensions/wikilinks.txt -> wikilinks.html test still pass unmodified" - id: "AC-FR-002-04" scenario: "Empty page name with text produces no link (consistent with `[[ ]]`)" given: "markdown.Markdown(extensions=['wikilinks'])" when: "converting 'foo [[ |text]] bar'" then: "output contains no 'foo bar

'" - id: "AC-FR-002-05" scenario: "More than one pipe is not treated as a piped link" given: "markdown.Markdown(extensions=['wikilinks'])" when: "converting '[[a|b|c]]'" then: "output is exactly '
